item.description:
# Simpler accounts, limits and setup
- Refresh Claude limits using the sign-in already in Claude. No separate live-limits connection. - Keep several Codex accounts open, with shared local chats and configuration. - Click an account to return to its existing window. Claude only restarts when you ask. - Find the exact account window through process and window IDs in the CLI. - A smaller Setup screen and native Liquid Glass controls.
Claude limits may ask once for access to Claude Safe Storage in macOS Keychain. If a refresh fails, the last measurement keeps its original time.

Claude limits now appear automatically from saved desktop measurements, with their age. OpenAccs reuses an existing Claude Code sign-in for live updates; connecting another account is optional.
- Cleaner account rows, visible actions, and one Refresh limits button. - Named removal confirmation. Claude profiles and shared history stay on disk. - `openaccs launch <account>… --json` or `launch --all --json` opens missing profiles in the background and leaves running ones untouched, including concurrent requests. - New Claude profiles hide their menu-bar icon by default.

Claude limits are now live, with one sign-in per account.
- Claude limits now come from Claude Code every 5 minutes: what's left of the 5-hour and weekly limits, when each resets, and your plan. - OpenAccs no longer shows the numbers the Claude app saves, because the app saves them only now and then, so they could be many hours old. A Claude row without live limits says so and has one Connect link. - Connect once per account. Every window of that account gets live limits from that one sign-in, including windows you add later. - Connect names the windows of the account and opens Anthropic's sign-in in a private window of your browser (Chrome, Brave, Edge or Firefox). Other browsers open it normally, with Copy link. Close other private windows first, because private windows share one sign-in. - OpenAccs checks that you signed in with that account and organization, and refuses any other. - The ✦ now marks every window of the account with the most left. - An open window's waiting count now reads "4 changes" instead of "4 chats changed", because it also counts pinned chats and app settings.
